title: When syncing to xDrip, only BG and basals are uploaded.
body:
**AndroidAPS** 3.1.0.3-dev-h
**Build**: `a608f55531`
**Flavor**: fullrelease / Engineering mode
**xDrip+**: version 344deb4-2022.11.16

**Problem description**:
When syncing to xDrip, treatments (Carbs & bolus) are missing. Only BG and basals are uploaded.

**Screenprints**
![aaps](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/45144129/219956834-24763aa1-f022-48a5-a79f-32b10484c188.jpg)
![xdrip](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/45144129/219956835-aa3ef5ac-579d-4d40-97a2-4e569471ea1f.jpg)

**Logfiles:**
[AndroidAPS_LOG_1676819528732.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/10777198/AndroidAPS_LOG_1676819528732.log.zip)

comments.body: Also the same here. To get SMB on xDrip I need to setup it to download treatments from NS.
I think some progress is beging made with the latest xDrip Nightly version: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/commit/fcd8063a4149c59d01bc668e191eaa3c6cee5c3e

@MilosKozak Really missing the option of syncing _all_ data to xDrip+
Any outlook/roadmap on a possible fix?
it will start work when xdrip team implement it

Issue fixed with xDrip latest nightly version: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2023.06.17

At least it's working for me. I think this ticket can now be closed.

> Issue fixed with xDrip latest nightly version: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2023.06.17
> At least it's working for me. I think this ticket can now be closed.

Partly. Now do see carbs and insulin treatments as data point being synced to NS.
But no basal rates. NA is showing default basal rates from current profile on NS

Also COB and IOB reported on NS is wrong...?

> ....I think this ticket can now be closed.
So, nope, not yet...

https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/commit/ec2f90f7ecb12a8305e4ed9166342fafcd065918

I have AAPS syncing all the info to NS and broadcasting the info to xDrip. I enabled "Enable Broadcast to xDrip+" and "Send status line to xDrip+" in AAPS.
